old: # Spain: incoming-worker special tax regime v1.2
new: # Spain: incoming-worker special tax regime v1.3

old: The effective-rate computation excludes both savings base and savings quota. In a salary-only ordinary category, the ceiling is `min(qualifying_foreign_tax, foreign_work_income ×ordinary_tax/O, 0.30 ×ordinary_tax)`.
new: The effective-rate computation excludes both savings base and savings quota. Express the effective percentage to two decimal places under LIRPF art. 80.2: `effective_percentage = round(100 × ordinary_tax / O, 2)`. In a salary-only ordinary category, the ceiling is `min(qualifying_foreign_tax, foreign_work_income × effective_percentage / 100, 0.30 ×ordinary_tax)`.

old: The salary-only effective-rate foreign-income limit is 77,307.69, but
new: The salary-only effective percentage is **25.77%**, expressed to two decimal places under LIRPF art. 80.2, giving a foreign-income limit of **77,310**, but

foreign_effective_percentage: round(100 * employment_tax / salary, 2)
  foreign_income_limit: foreign_work_salary * foreign_effective_percentage / 100
